title.zh: Reflection发布5010亿参数开源权重模型Beam

summary.zh: Reflection推出MoE架构开源模型Beam，总参数5010亿、激活参数230亿，定位对标中国开源模型。
summary.en: Reflection launched Beam, a 501B-parameter open-weight MoE model with 23B active parameters, pitched against Chinese open models.

title.zh: OpenAI在欧盟为ChatGPT和Codex文本加水印
title.en: OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in EU

summary.zh: OpenAI宣布在欧盟对ChatGPT和Codex生成文本添加水印，并计划在图像生成结果旁展示广告。
summary.en: OpenAI announced text watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex in the EU and plans for visual ads alongside image results.

title.zh: 巴西大选进入第二轮：弗拉维奥·博索纳罗首轮领先卢拉
title.en: Brazil heads to runoff with Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula

summary.zh: 计票99.73%时，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗得票47.08%，卢拉45.10%，两人将于10月25日进行决选。
summary.en: With 99.73% counted, Flavio Bolsonaro had 47.08% to Lula's 45.10%; the two meet in an Oct. 25 runoff.

body.zh:
据阿纳多卢通讯社报道，参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗在首轮投票中领先现任总统卢拉逾230万票，但未达到直接胜选所需的50%以上有效票。

这一结果与多数选前民调相反。45岁的弗拉维奥由其父、前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗亲自选定代表自由党参选。
body.en:
According to [Anadolu](https://aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-5-2026/4077995), Flavio Bolsonaro led President Lula by more than 2.3 million votes but fell short of the 50%-plus-one threshold.

The result reversed most pre-election polling. Flavio, 45, was handpicked by his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, to lead the Liberal Party ticket.

title.zh: 也门政府宣布全面军事行动收复胡塞控制区
title.en: Yemen launches full offensive to retake Houthi territory

summary.zh: 也门总统领导委员会主席阿利米宣布对胡塞武装发起全面军事行动，沙特领导的联军表示支持。
summary.en: Yemen's leadership council chief Rashad al-Alimi launched comprehensive operations against the Houthis, backed by the Saudi-led coalition.

title.zh: 四国峰会反对损害埃及苏丹水权的单边行动
title.en: Summit rejects unilateral moves on Egypt, Sudan water rights

summary.zh: 埃及、苏丹、厄立特里亚、索马里领导人发表《阿拉曼联合宣言》，反对损害埃苏水权的单边措施，涉及复兴大坝争端。
summary.en: Leaders of Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia issued the El Alamein declaration rejecting unilateral measures over Nile water amid the GERD dispute.

title.zh: AI乐观情绪推动纳指创新高
title.en: Nasdaq hits record on AI optimism

summary.zh: 10月5日纳指涨1.05%至27477.31点创纪录，标普500涨0.66%，AI乐观情绪抵消美债收益率上升影响。
summary.en: The Nasdaq rose 1.05% to a record 27,477.31 on Oct. 5 and the S&P 500 gained 0.66% as AI optimism offset rising yields.

title.zh: 国庆假期第五天道路交通平稳 6日迎返程高峰
title.en: Traffic steady on day five; return peak expected Oct. 6

summary.zh: 中国政府网消息，假期第五天全国道路交通平稳有序，预计6日迎来返程高峰。
summary.en: Road traffic was orderly on day five, with the return peak expected on Oct. 6, the government portal said.

title.zh: 出行热、体验丰、门市旺：国庆消费市场观察
title.en: Holiday consumption: travel, experiences and busy stores

summary.zh: 中新网报道，长线游、县域游和沉浸式体验带动假期消费。
summary.en: China News Service said long-haul trips, county tourism and immersive experiences drove holiday spending.

title.zh: 国务院安委办调度国庆假期安全防范工作
title.en: State Council safety office reviews holiday safety

summary.zh: 国务院安委办、应急管理部视频调度国庆假期安全防范工作，部署返程高峰安全保障。
summary.en: The State Council work safety office and emergency ministry held a video dispatch on holiday safety ahead of the return peak.
